title: Poor Value for the $$$
text: Poor Value for the $$$. These sheets seemed okay at first, but after washing them maybe half a dozen times, they have pulls in the fabric and are pilling, which means I'll have to toss them. I have several sets I alternate using, so even though I've had these a while, they haven't had much wear and should have held up much longer than this. I wouldn't recommend them to anybody.
